module purpose: This file implements system reset sequencing and synchronization (neorv32_sys_reset) and a clock-enable generator (neorv32_sys_clock). The reset unit sequences/deasserts rstn_ext_o and rstn_sys_o from shift registers and synchronizes watchdog/debug reset inputs to xrstn_wdt_o and xrstn_ocd_o; the clock unit samples enable_i, increments internal counters when enabled, and produces divided clock-enable pulses on clk_en_o.

use-case flows.value: external reset asserted (rstn_ext_i='0') clears sequencer registers and forces reset outputs low
delayed release of external reset: sreg_ext shifts ones and rstn_ext_o becomes the AND of sreg_ext
delayed release of system reset: sreg_sys shifts ones unless gated-clear by watchdog or debug resets, and rstn_sys_o is the AND of sreg_sys
synchronized reporting of watchdog and debug reset inputs on xrstn_wdt_o and xrstn_ocd_o (sampled to clk_i)
clock generator reset: rstn_i='0' clears en, cnt and cnt2
enable vector (enable_i) is collapsed to en (or_reduce_f) to enable/disable counting
when enabled, cnt increments and cnt2 copies cnt; transitions produce one-cycle pulses on clk_en_o fields (cnt(bit) and not cnt2(bit))

conceptual assets.concept: External reset release decision — the delayed deassertion of rstn_ext_o produced by a shift register
conceptual assets.reasoning: The sequencer shifts sreg_ext on each rising edge and drives rstn_ext_o as the AND of sreg_ext (RTL lines 51-52); when rstn_ext_i='0' the registers and outputs are forced to '0' (lines 44-46). The relationship map shows sreg_ext is a clocked register (CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 3, line 51) and rstn_ext_o is driven from that register (DERIVES_FROM rstn_ext_o at occurrence 3, line 52). This establishes the integrity property that rstn_ext_o's deassertion follows the sreg_ext fill rule implemented here.

conceptual assets.concept: System reset release decision — the deassertion of rstn_sys_o determined by sreg_sys and gated-clear by watchdog and debug reset inputs
conceptual assets.reasoning: The sequencer clears sreg_sys when rstn_wdt_i='0' or rstn_dbg_i='0', otherwise sreg_sys shifts ones; rstn_sys_o is the AND of sreg_sys (RTL lines 54-59). The map records that sreg_sys is a clocked register (CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 4, line 57) and rstn_sys_o derives from sreg_sys (DERIVES_FROM at occurrence 3, line 59). The gating inputs rstn_wdt_i and rstn_dbg_i appear as GATES on sreg_sys in the map (occurrence 2, line 54), showing they set the clear condition. The RTL and map thus establish that rstn_sys_o's integrity depends on sreg_sys and the watchdog/debug gate.

conceptual assets.concept: Synchronized watchdog reset output — the sampled (clocked) copy of rstn_wdt_i delivered on xrstn_wdt_o
conceptual assets.reasoning: The synchronizer process samples rstn_wdt_i to xrstn_wdt_o on rising_edge(clk_i) (RTL lines 71-72) and forces outputs low while rstn_ext_i='0' (lines 68-70). The map records that xrstn_wdt_o is driven by a COPIES assignment from rstn_wdt_i at occurrence 3 (line 72) and rstn_wdt_i CARRIES to xrstn_wdt_o (occurrence 3, line 72). As an output that other logic will consume, the RTL and map establish the integrity of the synchronized sample delivered on xrstn_wdt_o.

conceptual assets.concept: Synchronized debug/OCD reset output — the sampled (clocked) copy of rstn_dbg_i delivered on xrstn_ocd_o
conceptual assets.reasoning: The synchronizer samples rstn_dbg_i to xrstn_ocd_o on rising_edge(clk_i) (RTL line 73) and forces outputs low while rstn_ext_i='0' (lines 68-70). The map shows xrstn_ocd_o COPIES rstn_dbg_i at occurrence 3 (line 73) and rstn_dbg_i CARRIES to xrstn_ocd_o (occurrence 3, line 73). The RTL and map thus establish the integrity of the synchronized debug reset delivered by this module.

conceptual assets.concept: Clock-enable pulse generation — the divided clock-enable pulses driven on clk_en_o fields (per-bit pulses produced when cnt(bit) transitions)
conceptual assets.reasoning: The clock generator samples enable_i to en (en <= or_reduce_f(enable_i), line 129), increments cnt when en='1' and copies cnt to cnt2 (lines 130-136), and computes each clk_en_o field as cnt(bit) and not cnt2(bit) (lines 140-147). The map records GATED_BY relationships on clk_en_o fields (e.g. occurrence 2, line 140 guarded by cnt and cnt2), cnt and cnt2 are clocked registers (cnt CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 3, line 131; cnt2 CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 3, line 135), and enable_i SOURCES en (occurrence 2, line 129). The RTL and map therefore establish that clk_en_o outputs are produced by these stored counter states and the enable setting; consumers rely on their integrity.
